newsitem.title: UK: Abbey National squeezed to record high.
newsitem.headline: Abbey National squeezed to record high.

text.p: Shares in Abbey National Plc rose to a record high on Thursday, continuing recent gains on bid speculation and squeezed higher amid a shortage of stock in the market, traders said.
The stock was up 9p at 746 by 1017 GMT, after earlier rising as high as 747p -- surpassing the previous high of 738p set yesterday. Volume was active at 3.1 million shares.

"No-one's got any stock and they are just going up and up," said one market maker. Added another: "People are short, the financial sector is in a bid frenzy and Abbey has been mentioned as a possible target."
A report in the Financial Times noted talk that at least one sizeable financial sector bid or merger was poised to hit the market.
The paper said Abbey was being "aggressively bought" yesterday despite the company's recent insistance it was not involved in any bid or merger talks.
Abbey shares have also been bolstered in recent weeks by hopes that rising mortgage rates would lead to wider profit margins.
